# 🏦 Bank Management System

A console-based Bank Management System built using **Core Java**, **JDBC**, **MySQL**, **Maven**, and **Git**. This project demonstrates object-oriented programming, JDBC CRUD operations, database relationships, exception handling, and layered architecture.

---

## 🚀 Features

### 👤 Customer Management
- Add Customer
- View All Customers
- Search Customer by ID
- Update Customer Details
- Delete Customer

### 💳 Account Management
- Create Bank Account
- View Account Details
- Close Account

### 💰 Banking Operations
- Deposit Money
- Withdraw Money
- Transfer Money Between Accounts
- Check Account Balance 

### 📄 Transaction Management
- View Transaction History
- View Recent Transactions

---

## 🛠 Technologies Used

- Java
- JDBC
- MySQL 
- Maven 
- Git
- Eclipse IDE

## 🗄 Database Tables

### Customers

| Column | Type |
|---------|------|
| customer_id | INT |
| name | VARCHAR |
| age | INT |
| phone | VARCHAR |
| address | VARCHAR |

### Accounts

| Column | Type |
|---------|------|
| account_number | INT |
| customer_id | INT |
| account_type | VARCHAR |
| balance | DECIMAL |

### Transactions

| Column | Type |
|---------|------|
| transaction_id | INT |
| account_number | INT |
| transaction_type | VARCHAR |
| amount | DECIMAL |
| transaction_date | DATETIME |
